law.catch_line: Counterfeiting disabled parking license plates or placards; penalty

text.section: Any person who creates a counterfeit or unauthorized replica of a disabled parking license plate, DV disabled parking license plate which has been issued under subsection B of § 46.2-739, organizational removable windshield placard, permanent removable windshield placard, or temporary removable windshield placard, shall be guilty of a Class 2 misdemeanor.
The local governing body of any county, city, or town may by ordinance incorporate this provision by reference.
